thesis: Pullback long in an established uptrend: close 20.28 is above SMA20 (19.58), SMA50 (18.34) and SMA200 (16.21) after a post-earnings rerating, with RSI 61 and a defined 20.05-20.40 entry zone giving about 1.9 reward/risk to the 21.20 high (about 1.6 even at the last price). Health care (XLV) is among the regime's leading defensive sectors in a risk-off tape, valuation is low (forward P/E 7.36) and free cash flow is strong, and no earnings event falls inside the horizon. Conviction is capped by flat revenue, above-average volume on the down days, a stop only about 1 ATR away in a high-VIX tape, and an unreviewed Item 2.01 8-K, so the position should be small and tactical.
invalidation: A daily close below 19.70, or a close below the SMA20 (about 19.58) on rising volume.
key_risks: 8-K filed 2026-11-17 (Item 2.01, completed acquisition or disposition) has not been reviewed; read it before sizing
Stop at 19.70 is only about 1 ATR (0.539) below the entry, so with VIX at the 0.858 percentile one normal volatile day can trigger it
Down days came on above-average volume (13.3M on 11-18, 15.7M on 11-16 vs 9.0M average): mild distribution as the post-earnings drift fades
Revenue growth has gone from +8.1% to +4.9% to -0.3% YoY, the trailing GAAP margin is -4.1% and debt is 13.58B, so the cheap valuation may be a value trap
The book is already heavy in healthcare (lesson 6), so this adds to one correlated bet
Upside is limited: the 21.20 target and the 21.6 analyst mean are close to the 20.28 price
